items.discussion: editor-52 (Order 52), met at E311; repro: crates/vilan-lsp/src/editor_review_tests.rs e311 pin's `padding(style::Length::px(4))`
items.title: a TYPE in the middle of a module-qualified value path paints nothing — `Length` in `style::Length::px(4)`, `Overflow` in `style::Overflow::Hidden` (kolt views.vl:218, every `style::Length::rem(..)` in kolt) carry no semantic token, while `Theme` in `Theme::stroke1()` paints Struct
items.body: The analyzer records a type-reference row (`Program::type_references`) for a type that HEADS a value path (`Theme::stroke1()` -> `Theme`) but not for one reached through a module first (`style::Length::px`): the module segment paints Namespace (its `Expr::Module` entity), the leaf paints Function since E311's `path_leaf`, and the type between them is in no table, so neither hover-by-span nor tokens see it. Fix at the path resolution: record the middle segment's (source, span, definition) row as the head's is. Pins: `style::Length::px(4)`, `style::Overflow::Hidden`, a three-module path, the hover on the segment (the struct's declaration).

items.discussion: editor-52 (Order 52), met at E313; measured with VILAN_PHASE_TIMING=passes on the kolt client world (debug build)
items.title: E313's hover rows (E206 call labels, E237 definitions, E240 type-position rows, E241 patterns) are rendered for EVERY package file on every editor analysis - a served keystroke re-renders the cold prefix's rows the S2b label records already spare `expr_types` and `declaration_labels`
items.body: E313 made the four hover tables per-file (a module served as a view of its entry's world read the entry's rows at its own offsets). They are rendered in `analyze_over_world`'s tail for every non-std file under the reading aids except the declared `generated` root (kolt's lucide module held 17,601 of the world's 23,042 generic call sites). Debug-build pass split on the kolt client world: the call-label loop 3.3 -> 15.4 ms, the three hover tables 8.4 -> 16.2 ms (release is a fraction; E292's served row is incr-52a's measure). The rows are a pure function of the settled types, exactly like S2b's label rows: recording them per module (`ModuleTables`) and skipping `label_row_restored` modules at the tail would pay the hot set only. Owner of the record plumbing: the incremental lane. Pins to add with it: the reuse pin (an unseeded session), the view-row pins of E313 green on a served keystroke.

items.discussion: editor-52 (Order 52), met at E310 on kolt login_page.vl:72
items.title: a function's signature label drops an IMPLICIT parameter's trait arguments - `fun login_block(username: Signal<str>, password: Signal<str>)` hovers as `fun login_block(username: Signal, password: Signal)`
items.body: An implicit generic (`x: Signal<str>`) renders by its constraint NAME (B261's bare rendering), which is the trait's name without its arguments; the declaration label prints that. The parameter's own hover (E237's block) and E310's trait hover carry the arguments. Fix in the signature label writer: an implicit generic's position prints its bound (`Signal<str>`), not the binder name. Pins: a one-argument trait parameter, two parameters of one trait at different arguments, a bound written `<S: Signal<str>>` (unchanged: `S`).

items.discussion: editor-52 (Order 52), met at E306; pin editor_review_tests::e306_a_variant_in_value_position_hovers_with_its_enum (its `None` leg)
items.title: a generic enum's variant in value position whose expression type was not tabled hovers with the bare enum - a returned `None` (`fun nothing(): Option<i32> { None }`) reads `Option::None`, where `Some(1)`'s and a bound `None`'s read `Option<i32>::…`
items.body: E306's variant hover spells the value's instantiation from `expr_types` of the reference; a tail `None` whose type was settled only through the return records no label on its own id. Read it from the expected type (the return slot, the binding) where the reference has none, as E241 does from the matched type.
